notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAobjectInstancesRemoved value. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application class/member names. It correlates three successful receive-order Delete Object Instance calls with exactly one receiver removal callback each, checks baseline-relative direct counts, and verifies the final HLAsetTiming periodic value and standard reflection metadata. Timestamped removal/retraction, service-reporting extensions, DDM regions, provider-specific headers, registries, names, and diagnostics are outside this slice.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM value requests, object-class publication/subscription, object registration, receive-order deletion and HLAsetTiming control, with FederateAmbassador discovery/removal/reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador object-management, MOM, callback, and HLAinteger32BE declarations
